components.claim: A conventional dense global-attention model provides the quality and systems anchor needed to interpret hybrid efficiency.
components.quality: All six frozen cells are complete. Candidate-minus-control endpoint loss is -0.039170/-0.042662/-0.037184 nats; mean -0.039672 and upper one-sided 95% bound -0.034996 pass the +0.01 margin. All eleven source bounds pass, so the whole-architecture proxy quality screen passes without component attribution.
components.systems: At 128K the historical dense geometry has about 1.92 GiB analytic BF16 state and 25.10 GFLOP/token. Across the proxy pairs, the candidate uses 21.49% fewer analytic FLOPs/token, 10.01% less steady time, 10.42% less active time, and 11.13% more steady throughput, but 20.77% more peak allocation. Mean time-to-quality improvement is 19.48% with lower one-sided 95% bound 16.83%; no pair is censored. Dense controls still fail the frozen 1.0-hour envelope, so no paired hard-envelope or serving claim passes.
unresolved_risks: first dense attempt was operator-interrupted after step 1 with no checkpoint; its identical preregistered attempt 2 is in progress under the fresh v2 gate
the full 12-transition temporary simulation passes; terminal service provenance and a redundant finalizer next_run check are deferred hardening because the active runner is hash-frozen

every analysis view preserves the two fixed data-order strata and censoring is fail-closed; redundant inline descriptive-only labels on three secondary pooled blocks are deferred because the analyzer is hash-frozen

all controls precede all candidates across a five-day forecast with no power, thermal, clock, throttle, or host telemetry, so timing is descriptive and cannot support causal speedup, energy, dollar, serving, or systems-promotion claims

training loss/gradient finiteness is fail-fast and the validation schedule covers all 11 sources, but the frozen analyzer checks only identical reported sets; the append-only completeness sidecar is mandatory before interpretation

components.claim: Removing global RoPE preserves language quality and improves long-context capability within the selected recurrent mixer.
components.quality: The only clean from-scratch same-mixer result is seed-42 GDN: NoPE is 0.024367 nats worse than RoPE32. It improves content sensitivity but not exact retrieval. The three-seed KDA/NoPE versus GDN/RoPE frontier is positionally and mixer-confounded.
components.systems: Within each mixer, RoPE32 and NoPE0 have identical parameters and current analytic FLOPs; seed-42 prefill and training differences were below claim authority. Real rotary/runtime cost remains to be measured.
components.runtime_support: GDN RoPE/NoPE and KDA NoPE execute; KDA RoPE geometry is expressible but has no powered training preflight
unresolved_risks: longer-context RoPE scaling is a separate question
components.next_gate: after the active finalist, v3-accept and reuse its six KDA/NoPE cells, register the frozen factorial unchanged, and materialize the 18 missing runs

components.claim: Sigmoid is the preferred recurrent output-gate activation on the selected sequence parent.
components.quality: One clean seed-42 GDN/RoPE language contrast favors sigmoid by 0.037337 nats, but synthetic MQAR favors GDN-SiLU 3/3 over GDN-sigmoid 0/3. KDA-sigmoid passes 3/3 and KDA-SiLU is missing, so gate utility is parent/task conditional.
components.systems: SiLU and sigmoid keep parameters and current analytic FLOPs fixed; realized activation/kernel behavior is unmeasured on the selected parent.
components.runtime_support: GDN supports both; KDA hardcodes sigmoid and KDA-SiLU is not config-expressible
components.next_gate: after mixer/position selection and the active finalist, qualify a default-sigmoid KDA code successor if needed, then run the exact six-pair same-parent SiLU/sigmoid study

components.claim: Compressing each of the five conservative global memories can reduce serving state without the Reader Attention capability loss.
components.systems: Raw MQA1 and MLA128 each reduce five-cache BF16 state analytically by 66.7%. Raw MQA1 has 152,975,898 parameters and 1,015,703,040 FLOPs/token at 4K; parameter-matched MQA1 adds 967,680 FFN parameters and 5,806,080 FLOPs/token, so it is a compound sensitivity rather than pure representation evidence. No realized result exists.
